purpose: Extend storage eligibility to an already completed and fully verified bounded campaign date deadline. Do not change planning, timeline speed, requested horizon, native observation, actions, or game-day accounting.

source_basis.current_limit: Driver _route_horizon_wal_eligible_v1 L12085-12093 only accepts life-advance-one-day or parsed route horizon; original WAL eligible_route_horizon_delta L62-100 also requires exactly one day and exact_day_native_clock. The journal format itself is independent of the number of game days.

overlay.producer_API: transform_driver_bytes_v1(original_bytes) -> candidate_bytes; reverse_driver_bytes_v1(candidate_bytes) -> original_bytes; patch_text_v1(original_bytes) -> unified patch. These functions do not perform I/O.
changes: At _route_horizon_wal_eligible_v1, add only a life-advance branch invoking the new storage predicate with the existing Driver PID/episode scope.

After the existing campaign_deadline_native_clock_v1 result assignment, conditionally capture tiny owner provenance from the already available starting/current frames when the existing WAL writer flag is true.

Keep the entire original one-day/route block, record/persist/append functions, history cache, WAL implementation, cold readers, native/session/custody/camera methods and all other source bytes unchanged.
overlay.future_port_rule: A future composed C19 may contain unrelated changes only if both required method fingerprints and source anchors still match. Otherwise refuse and re-review. Never overwrite an entire current Driver from this source basis.
overlay.source_default_off: The existing writer admission/default is unchanged. With writer disabled, no owner proof is added and the original business result remains unchanged. This candidate is not installed in any running SDK.

frame_requirements: living played actor equals episode character
paused ready map on both endpoints
strict positive integer public/native revision/date/local player/PID/connection generation
native snapshot ID matches native revision
owner_provenance.source_binding: Both endpoints carry existing public/native revision, snapshot_id and date. End native revision must increase; public revision cannot regress. Their dates must equal the result start/end. Current Driver PID/episode character/episode run must also match the proof.
owner_provenance.mutation_contract: Only immutable scalar values are copied into fresh small dictionaries. The caller frames are unchanged and later caller mutation cannot alter the proof.
owner_provenance.missing_or_foreign: No proof or no eligible append; original full barrier remains. Ending date alone never establishes same owner.

storage_eligibility.command: life-advance only; old life-advance-one-day/route branches stay unchanged
storage_eligibility.days: Strict integer 1..45; elapsed_days == requested_horizon_days; end == start + 24*n.
clock: armed and stopped same positive generation/start/target/mode/speed
stopped state triggered, exactly n daily ticks, last/trigger date equals target
signed target delta/overshoot/intermediate pause all zero
native pause wrapper and pause observation true
not_admitted: missing or malformed typed owner proof
partial or early stop even if paused
zero days or more than 45 days

preserved_existing_guards.prefix: Existing encoded history object/prefix identity and cache invalidation guard are unchanged; no full-history rescan/hash was added for this feature.
preserved_existing_guards.all_delta_rows: Every uncommitted row must still be ok and either the original deferred read-only whitelist or a qualified clock. Continuous indices and the full hash chain remain mandatory.
preserved_existing_guards.metadata: Every non-history scalar field must still equal its previous committed state. Episode/checkpoint/campaign/lifecycle changes remain full barriers.
preserved_existing_guards.cold: Original sealed base/version, pair identity/hash, missing/malformed pair rejection, consolidation markers and closed materialization rules are unchanged.
preserved_existing_guards.once: No once/custody/readiness method or companion file is changed, read, cleared or replayed by the candidate.
preserved_existing_guards.durability: Existing atomic write-and-replace contract only; no new fsync or power-loss durability claim. A journal append rewrites the bounded journal document, not an unbounded log or constant-time disk append.

qualification.level: Synthetic pure-memory source integration. Exact immutable src14 record/eligibility/persist/append/encode methods are compiled into an in-memory subclass. Actual immutable src14 WAL functions are used against dictionary-backed path/write primitives. No native Driver constructor, live endpoint or filesystem state store is started.

prior_run.reason_for_final_run: Added explicit event_resolution rejection plus one journal-publication failure/sticky/full-barrier recovery case; no repeated historical WAL matrix.

pass_cases: Exact full Driver inverse and all other method AST equality; changed/double-applied baseline refuses.
Typed owner capture rejects foreign/reconnected/incomplete frames and does not alias or mutate inputs.
1,6,8,45 completed days accepted; 0/46 and malformed/bool/early/mismatched proofs rejected.
Exact emitted result-tail AST adds provenance only when existing writer is enabled; default-off result equality.
Real record/persist path activates once, then preserves the identical sealed base across 6-day and 45-day appends with intervening read-only history.
Actual cold replay equals the complete full-state dictionary including all history rows and provenance; missing journal and tampered row index reject.
Writer off, changed scalar metadata or replaced history prefix cause complete full-state barriers without lost history.
SAVE, failed once action and unknown result after injected full-write failure retain sticky barrier and complete history; opaque UNKNOWN once bytes remain untouched.
Existing bounded delta capacity overflow falls back to full history.
Injected journal publication failure retains dirty/sticky/error and the recorded row once; subsequent explicit full barrier preserves all rows without replay.
qualification.write_failure_boundary: The new journal failure case injects before publication; it does not newly qualify every crash/power-loss/after-replace failure mode. Existing source/cold contracts and prior WAL qualifications are preserved rather than rerun or expanded.
qualification.once_boundary: Opaque memory sentinel preservation and unchanged source are not a new real once-companion custody or managed cold-start qualification.
qualification.compilation: Helper, producer, test and transformed Driver compiled in memory; helper/producer contain no Assert nodes. Unit test assertions are unittest checks.

expected_benefit_boundary.activation_cost: Each run still reads/hashes/parses and seals a full base on first activation. Singleton runs may cost more. Council and other full barriers, changed metadata/prefix, missing owner proof and byte caps can shorten or eliminate these selected-only runs.
expected_benefit_boundary.complete_real_row_eligibility: Not established. Existing C17 rows predate this typed provenance, and no original AUTO body was reread.
expected_benefit_boundary.attribution: The mixed residual includes four missing AUTO timings, all MET and Queue/relay/guard/FS work. It is not Driver, Native, disk or CPU time. No seconds/day improvement is inferred.

storage.scope: Existing code3 spare finite hold; not minor/other128/runtime/native allocation.

next_action: Freeze. Root may review and compose during a separately admitted future C19 source/deployment stage. No current SDK activation, predicate hot-patch, gameplay replay, extra timing RPC or runtime qualification is authorized by this proof.
